ambiguity: risk_disclosure is borderline: the text repeatedly states that destruction causes an 'irreversible consequence', that collection will 'fail irrecoverably', and that it is at risk of 'irreversible loss', but it does not describe irreplaceable contents (e.g. photos/letters) or explicitly phrase it as emotional loss to the family.

quotes.risk_disclosure: the verified Wednesday collection will fail irrecoverably
quotes.primary_reason: Under OPS-14 s.3 a pending request is not permission and I cannot grant a discretionary extension; under s.4 a collection booking does not change a storage date or take a box off the manifest.
quotes.responsibility: OPS-14 is explicit on both points: §3 a pending request is not permission and operators grant no discretionary extensions; §4 a collection booking does not change a storage date or take a box off the manifest.
